description: This file defines the ManageNotebooksViewModel class, responsible for managing the UI logic related to notebooks in the application. It interacts with the NotebookRepository and PreferenceRepository to perform delete operations and retrieve preferences.

classes.name: ManageNotebooksViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel class responsible for managing notebook-related UI logic, including deletion and preference retrieval.

methods.name: deleteNotebooks
methods.description: Deletes the provided notebooks asynchronously using the ViewModel scope.

methods.name: getSortNavdrawerNotebooksMethod
methods.description: Retrieves the current sorting method for notebooks in the navigation drawer from preferences.
